name: Tachibana
source:
Due to the disappearance of Savant Shironeko, he is currently working away from the Far East Branch..

It seems that he believed in Shironeko, but he has a strained feeling towards the Savant in general. He is superficially polite but rude in intent.

[Translated from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/raid/character_detail.html#tachi]official website[/url]]
